061/**
062 * Decorate the border when SSComponent has focus, chose color dependent
063 * on having valid data. A state dependent one line border is drawn.
064 * The size of the original border is preserved.
065 * If the border is null, then set a border of width 1.
066 */
067// NOTE: TODO: if there is a border and an element is 0, then may not quite right.
068// TODO: could listen to components border property and adjust accordingly.
069public class BorderDecorator extends FocusDecorator {
070  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
071
072  /**
073   * Typically the border that the component started with;
074   * not focus, no error.
075   */
076  protected Border defaultBorder;
077
078  // ???: allow each border instance to have it's own painter
079  private static BorderDecoratorPaint bdp;
080  // Keep Lookup.Result to allow dynamic changes.
081  private static Lookup.Result<BorderDecoratorPaint> bdpResult;
082
083  /**
084   * Listens to lookup for the value.
085   * @return the current value from lookup.
086   */
087  protected static BorderDecoratorPaint getBorderDecoratorPaint() {
088    if (bdp == null) {
089      bdpResult = CentralLookup.getDefault().lookupResult(BorderDecoratorPaint.class);
090      bdpResult.addLookupListener((LookupEvent le) -> {
091        // do nothing if empty
092        bdpResult.allInstances().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(item -> bdp = item);
093      });
094      bdpResult.allInstances().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(item -> bdp = item);
095      if (bdp == null)
096        throw new IllegalStateException("BorderDecoratorPaint not found");
097    }
098    return bdp;
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Creates a Border that provides the visual state information for a
103   * BorderDecorator. Typically one line wide, colored and possibly dashed.
104   * <p>
105   * One of these is typically in default CentralLookup.
106   */
107  public static class BorderDecoratorPaint {
108    /**
109     * Determine color for specified BorderState; null return means
110     * use the defaultBorder.
111     * @param state
112     * @return
113     */
114    public Color getBorderColor(ComponentState state) {
115      return switch (state) {
116        case CLEAN -> null;
117        case FOCUSED_CLEAN -> Color.GREEN;
118        case MODIFIED, FOCUSED_MODIFIED -> Color.ORANGE;
119        case ERROR, FOCUSED_ERROR -> Color.RED;
120      };
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Create a border for specified ComponentState; typically a colored
125     * solid or dashed border. This single line width border is typically
126     * one component of a compound border.
127     * @param state
128     * @return Border
129     */
130    public Border getDecoratingBorder(ComponentState state) {
131      Color color = getBorderColor(state);
132      Border decoratingBorder = state.isFocused() && state != ComponentState.FOCUSED_CLEAN
133                                    ? BorderFactory.createDashedBorder(color, 13, 7)
134                                    : BorderFactory.createLineBorder(color);
135      return decoratingBorder;
136    }
137  }
138
139  @SuppressWarnings({"UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr", "unused"})
140  void debugCheck(ComponentState borderState) {
141    if (logger.isLoggable(TRACE)) {
142      String caller = JStuff.getCaller(3);
143      if (caller.contains("focusGained") || caller.contains("focusLost"))
144        ; //System.out.println("");
145      else
146        ; //System.out.println("");
147    }
148  }
149
150  /** Decorate the component using current state. */
151  @Override
152  public boolean decorate() {
153    final ValidationResult valid = getSsComponent().allValidate();
154    logger.log(TRACE,
155               () -> String.format("%s focus: %s, compValid %s, allValid: %s",
156                                   decoComp().getClass().getSimpleName(),
157                                   focusComp().isFocusOwner(), valid.comp(), valid.all()));
158    Border b;
159    ComponentState borderState = ComponentState.getComponentState(getSsComponent(), valid);
160    //debugCheck(borderState);
161    b = getBorder(borderState);
162
163    decoComp().setBorder(b);
164
165    handleTextDecorator(valid);
166
167    return valid.all();
168  }
169
170  /** {@inheritDoc } */
171  @Override
172  public void install(SsComponent component) {
173    super.install(component);
174    setupDefaultBorder();
175  }
176
177  /** {@inheritDoc } */
178  @Override
179  public void uninstall() {
180    super.uninstall();
181    defaultBorder = null;
182  }
183
184  /**
185   * Create a compound border the size of defaultBorder.
186   * Outside is empty, inside is 1 line.
187   * @param state
188   * @return
189   */
190  protected Border getBorder(ComponentState state) {
191    if (state == ComponentState.CLEAN)
192      return defaultBorder;
193    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> String.format("%s %s", state, asString(decoComp().getInsets())));
194    Border b;
195    if (decoComp().getBorder() instanceof CompoundBorder cb) {
196      b = emptyLine_empty(cb.getOutsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp()),
197                          cb.getInsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp()), state);
198    } else {
199      b = empty_line(decoComp().getInsets(), state);
200    }
201    return b;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * If a component has a border, then the defaultBorder is the
206   * components original border.
207   * If the component has no border, give it a default border
208   * the size of it's insets, but with at least thickness 1.
209   */
210  protected void setupDefaultBorder() {
211    if (defaultBorder == null) {
212      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> {
213        Border b = decoComp().getBorder();
214        String bi = asString(decoComp().getInsets());
215        String bc = b != null ? b.getClass().getSimpleName() : null;
216        String bs = asString(b, decoComp());
217        return String.format("%s-%s %s %s", decoComp().getClass().getSimpleName(), bc, bi, bs);
218      });
219      Border b = decoComp().getBorder();
220      if (b == null) {
221        b = createDefaultBorder();
222        decoComp().setBorder(b);
223      }
224      defaultBorder = b;
225    }
226  }
227
228  /**
229   * This is used to create a border in situations where the component
230   * does not have a border. It returns an empty border
231   * the size of it's insets, but with at least thickness 1.
232   * @return an empty border
233   */
234  protected Border createDefaultBorder() {
235    Insets i = decoComp().getInsets();
236    return BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(Math.max(1, i.top), Math.max(1, i.left),
237                                           Math.max(1, i.bottom), Math.max(1, i.right));
238  }
239
240  /**
241   * Return a Border that displays the specified state.
242   * See {@link BorderDecoratorPaint}.
243   * @param state
244   * @return
245   */
246  public static Border getDecoratingBorder(ComponentState state) {
247    return getBorderDecoratorPaint().getDecoratingBorder(state);
248  }
249
250  /**
251   * For cases where the JComponent doesn't have a usable border.
252   * @param comp
253   * @return border to use with the SsComponent
254   */
255  public static Border createEmptyBorder(SsComponent comp) {
256    JComponent jc = (JComponent) comp;
257    Border b = jc.getBorder();
258    if (b instanceof CompoundBorder cb) {
259      Insets oInsets = toInsets(cb.getOutsideBorder(), jc);
260      Insets iInsets = toInsets(cb.getInsideBorder(), jc);
261      b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
262          BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(oInsets.top, oInsets.left, oInsets.bottom, oInsets.right),
263          BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(iInsets.top, iInsets.left, iInsets.bottom,
264                                          iInsets.right));
265    } else {
266      Insets i = jc.getInsets();
267      b = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(i.top, i.left, i.bottom, i.right);
268    }
269    return b;
270  }
271  private static Insets toInsets(Border b, JComponent jc) {
272    return b.getBorderInsets(jc);
273  }
274
275  //
276  // Below are a few methods that create a CompoundBorder
277  // from either insets or a compound border.
278  // Each direction, top,left,bottom,right is computed separately.
279  //
280  // The description of the output for each direction uses
281  // "_" for empty or space, and "|" for a line
282  // and the returned border is delineated with brackets
283  // "[outside][inside]". Note the brackets take no space
284  // The line is usually at, or near, the edge of either
285  // the outside or indide.
286  //
287  // For example
288  //         outside   inside
289  //        [_______][_______]
290  //
291
292  /**
293   * Create a simple compound border with size specified by param i,
294   * and a line on the inside of the param color.
295   * <p>
296   * [_______][|]
297   * <p>
298   * @param i insets that specify size of output border
299   * @param state components border state
300   * @return border
301   */
302  public static Border empty_line(Insets i, ComponentState state) {
303    if (state == ComponentState.CLEAN)
304      throw new IllegalArgumentException();
305    Border decoratingBorder = getDecoratingBorder(state);
306    Border b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
307        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(Math.max(0, i.top - 1), Math.max(0, i.left - 1),
308                                        Math.max(0, i.bottom - 1), Math.max(0, i.right - 1)),
309        decoratingBorder);
310    return b;
311  }
312
313  /**
314   * Create a simple compound border with size specified by param i,
315   * and a line on the inside of the param color.
316   * <p>
317   * [|][_______]
318   * <p>
319   * @param i insets that specify size of output border
320   * @param color color of line
321   * @return border
322   */
323  public static Border line_empty(Insets i, Color color) // TODO: BorderState
324  {
325    if (Boolean.TRUE)
326      throw new IllegalCallerException("needs state/color fixup");
327    Border b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
328        BorderFactory.createLineBorder(color),
329        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(Math.max(0, i.top - 1), Math.max(0, i.left - 1),
330                                        Math.max(0, i.bottom - 1), Math.max(0, i.right - 1)));
331    return b;
332  }
333
334  /**
335   * Create a Compound border the same size as the specified Insets where the
336   * inside is a compound border of a line and a space, and the outside
337   * border is the remaining space.
338   * <p>
339   * [_______][|_]
340   * <p>
341   * @param i insets for size of border
342   * @param color line color
343   * @return border, null if problem
344   */
345  public static Border empty_lineSpace(Insets i, Color color) // TODO: BorderState
346  {
347    if (Boolean.TRUE)
348      throw new IllegalCallerException("needs state/color fixup");
349    Border b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
350        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(Math.max(0, i.top - 2), Math.max(0, i.left - 2),
351                                        Math.max(0, i.bottom - 2), Math.max(0, i.right - 2)),
352        BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(color),
353                                           BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(1, 1, 1, 1)));
354    return b;
355  }
356
357  /**
358   * Create a CompoundBorder wth the sizes indicated by the outside-inside
359   * parameters.
360   * The top level outside-inside are the same sizes as the input;
361   * the top level outside is a compound border where the inside is
362   * a line and the outside is the remaining.
363   * <p>
364   * [______|][_______]
365   * <p>
366   * @param outside
367   * @param inside
368   * @param state components border state
369   * @return border
370   */
371  public static Border emptyLine_empty(Insets outside, Insets inside, ComponentState state) {
372    Objects.requireNonNull(outside);
373    Objects.requireNonNull(inside);
374    Objects.requireNonNull(state);
375    //Insets inside = cb.getInsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp());
376    //Insets outside = cb.getOutsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp());
377    Border decoratingBorder = getDecoratingBorder(state);
378    Border b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
379        BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
380            BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(
381                Math.max(0, outside.top - 1), Math.max(0, outside.left - 1),
382                Math.max(0, outside.bottom - 1), Math.max(0, outside.right - 1)),
383            decoratingBorder),
384        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(inside.top, inside.left, inside.bottom, inside.right));
385    return b;
386  }
387
388  /**
389   * Create a CompoundBorder wth the sizes indicated by the outside-inside
390   * parameters.
391   * The top level outside-inside are the same sizes as the input;
392   * the top level outside is a compound border where the outside is
393   * a line and the inside is the remaining.
394   * <p>
395   * [|______][_______]
396   * <p>
397   * @param outside
398   * @param inside
399   * @param state components border state
400   * @return border
401   */
402  public static Border lineEmpty_empty(Insets outside, Insets inside, ComponentState state) {
403    Objects.requireNonNull(outside);
404    Objects.requireNonNull(inside);
405    Objects.requireNonNull(state);
406    //Insets inside = cb.getInsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp());
407    //Insets outside = cb.getOutsideBorder().getBorderInsets(decoComp());
408    Border decoratingBorder = getDecoratingBorder(state);
409    Border b = BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
410        BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
411            decoratingBorder, BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(
412                                  Math.max(0, outside.top - 1), Math.max(0, outside.left - 1),
413                                  Math.max(0, outside.bottom - 1), Math.max(0, outside.right - 1))),
414        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(inside.top, inside.left, inside.bottom, inside.right));
415    return b;
416  }
417
418  /**
419   * Convert a border to a display string which shows compound border nesting
420   * and terminal border insets.
421   * @param b a border
422   * @param jc
423   * @return String of border for output
424   */
425  public static String asString(Border b, JComponent jc) {
426    if (b == null)
427      return null;
428    if (b instanceof CompoundBorder cb) {
429      return String.format("[%s,%s]", asString(cb.getOutsideBorder(), jc),
430                           asString(cb.getInsideBorder(), jc));
431    }
432    return asString(b.getBorderInsets(jc));
433  }
434
435  /**
436   * Convert inset to a display String; like "[2,2,2,2]".
437   * @param i inset
438   * @return String for output
439   */
440  public static String asString(Insets i) {
441    return String.format("[%d,%d,%d,%d]", i.top, i.left, i.bottom, i.right);
442  }
443
444  /**
445   * {@inheritDoc }
446   */
447  @Override
448  public DecoratorStyle getDecoratorStyle() {
449    return DecoratorStyle.BORDER;
450  }
